SRFTI students protest, demand VC resignation amid campus violence

Students at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI) have begun an indefinite sit-in protest, demanding the resignation of the Vice-Chancellor (VC) due to alleged campus violence. Reports indicate the VC was "allegedly manhandled" and the VC's office was vandalized amidst the ongoing protest.
